description: Workstream definition — one per-entry file per strategic workstream in the workstream store, which is queried directly; the markdown render it once fed is retired. Rewritten atomically (write-temp + rename, single writer, low-contention assumption); status/deliverable-completion mutations are field-scoped events (see workstream-event.schema.json), never in-place definition edits. Spec backlink: pln-project-tracker-render-from-qu-41e413 § Approach / § Substrate (definitions) / § Chunks C2.

workstream_id.description: Stable identifier for this workstream; also the filename stem (state/workstreams/<workstream_id>.yaml). Immutable once minted.

title.description: Human-readable workstream name for this workstream entry.

created.description: Date the workstream was created (YYYY-MM-DD). Part of the render-order tiebreaker: (created, workstream_id) per § Approach finding 3.

coordinator_root_path.description: Dual-tenant discriminator, repo-root-relative: "." is the auto-resolve value (the coordinator root is the repo root); a monorepo sub-root is its relative path (for example "subdir"). Never absolute and never a repo basename: either mints a machine-specific repo identity and fragments the join key. No value of this field alone expresses a routed write (a record whose owning repo is not the repo hosting the store): an independent git root is not a path under the hosting root, and a relative escape resolves against the reader's cwd. A routed write needs a companion owner-qualified `repo` field ('<owner>/<repo>'), which this schema does not carry; until it exists a routed value is unspecified and a writer must not invent one. The generator filters by this field so each repo's render includes only its own entries. Same composite-natural-key component as the engine's trackers.py.

deliverables.description: Ordered list of deliverable slots for this workstream. Completion state is NOT recorded here — it is a field-scoped event (field: 'deliverable[i].done') per the definition/event boundary (finding 6). Adding a new slot is a definition edit (rare); checking an existing one is an event (frequent). The generator's fold is union-tolerant: an event referencing a slot not yet present in a stale definition snapshot renders as a pending/orphan line rather than being silently dropped.

text.description: Deliverable description, as rendered in the tracker's checkbox line.

specs.description: Spec links associated with this workstream (paths under docs/plans/, docs/decisions/, etc.).

dependency_annotations.description: Free-text dependency notes carried forward from the hand-edited tracker format (e.g. 'blocked by X', 'depends on Y').
